items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: Because after Robertson came back we did a few things, quite a few things

ctx.x: And he said go ahead, I'll let you know. I said just let me know when you're ready, and wherever I am, I'll come in. He said oh, don't worry about it.
So, I went with Claud to do a few dates, and while we were out the singer, Claud Hopkins' singer, hm, hm, hm, hm hm, hm, thin man.
